# BottomSheet

A sheet over the screen for detail on demand — here, why one person scored a meal the way they did.

`NomNom.BottomSheet` · Overlays

## Use

```jsx
<NomNom.BottomSheet title="…">…</NomNom.BottomSheet>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="NomNom.BottomSheet" title="…">…</x-import>
```
